== Acquisition ==
Part of [[Togo (disguise)|Togo's]] replacement [[skill bar]] during [[The Tengu Accords]] mission.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Ancestors' Rage}}
* {{skill icon|Spear of Archemorus (skill)}}
* {{skill icon|Vital Blessing}}

== Notes ==
* This skill cannot be used until the Rage Bar is filled. After the Rage Bar has been filled once, Dragon Empire Rage can be used whenever it recharges. The Rage Bar fills when Togo makes, or contributes to kills.
* The damage is not [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]].

==Trivia==
* According to [[lore]], only the descendants of First Emperor [[Kaineng Tah]] are able to use this skill.
